concepts.angle: Diagonal two-tone split + giant offer type
concepts.based_on: Inspiration PDF 10.18.26, page 1: ComfoFeet Black Friday diagonal split, two shoes, huge sale type
concepts.headline: THE BIG COMFORT SALE
concepts.prompt: Square-style sale ad on a diagonal two-tone split background (deep forest green top-left, warm tan bottom-right). Huge heavy white headline across the top "THE BIG COMFORT SALE" in two lines. Two shoes of the reference colorway floating at dynamic angles, large and sharp, crossing the split. Bottom-left: giant heavy white "40% OFF" numeral; under it two solid black pills "30-DAY MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE" and "FREE SHIPPING". All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin.
